summary.text: Brad Olson is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 38 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Susan Pha.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026, and ran for Minnesota House District 38A in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Olson was the Republican candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 38A in 2024, when he lost the November 5 general election to Huldah Hiltsley, 34.9 percent to 64.8 percent.
